description: The common part of a query a structural requester or an Integration Sidecar opens on a hitl_contact_<audience> topic (architecture §3.5.2, implementation §10.1). Each kind adds its details in a schema of its own; a channel that has none for a kind validates against this one. The common fields are in data.schema.json.

kind.description: What the query is about. Known values: result_delivery, budget_exceeded, gate_approval, egress_unavailable and those of architecture §3.15.7.

scope.description: Known values: trace, network, niche, audience, egress, call (architecture §3.5.2).

since.description: When the condition the query is about started.

options.description: The admissible answers, a closed enumeration; absent in a delivery without options (architecture §3.5.4).

outcome_if_silent.description: The element of options the requester applies if nobody answers.

evidence.description: The observed facts that support the condition, raw (architecture §3.5.2).

details.description: The decision's data, with the fields each kind fixes (implementation §10.1).
